title: RETRACTION: Impact of Coastal Tourism Demand on Fisheries Industry Sustainability: A Suggested Framework for Blue Growth
content:
RETRACTION: M. Alsaleh, X. Wang, Z. Nan, R. Liu, and Q. Sun, “ Impact of Coastal Tourism Demand on Fisheries Industry Sustainability: A Suggested Framework for Blue Growth,” Natural Resources Forum (Early View): https://doi.org/10.1111/1477-8947.12332.

The above article, published online on 01 September 2023 in Wiley Online Library (wileyonlinelibrary.com), has been retracted by agreement between; the journal Editor-in-Chief, Mohammad Reza Salamat; and John Wiley & Sons Ltd. The retraction has been agreed following an investigation by the publisher. Several flaws and inconsistencies in the results presented and the experimental methods described were found, and the editors consider the conclusions of this article to be invalid.
